name: Fix autumn card photo alignment

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/fix-autumn-card-photo-alignment.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  fix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Normalize autumn mobile card image heights and title positions
        run: |
          cat >> style.css <<'EOF'

/* 2026-10-01 mobile autumn cards: equal photo frames and title alignment */
@media(max-width:760px){
  #autumn-menu .cards > .card > img{
    display:block!important;
    width:100%!important;
    height:auto!important;
    aspect-ratio:4/3!important;
    object-fit:cover!important;
    object-position:center!important;
    margin:0!important;
  }
  #autumn-menu .cards > .card > h3{
    margin:8px 0 0!important;
    padding:0!important;
    min-height:0!important;
    align-items:initial!important;
  }
}
EOF
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('index.html')
          s=p.read_text()
          import re
          s=re.sub(r'style\.css\?v=[^"\']+', 'style.css?v=20261001-2046', s, count=1)
          p.write_text(s)
          PY
      - name: Commit fix
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add style.css index.html
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Align autumn mobile card photos and titles"
          git push
